# Robust note parsing: handle missing director marker
entries = [e.split("\n") for e in content.split("\n\n") if e.strip()]
for entry in entries:
    if len(entry) < 2:
        continue
    title = entry[0]
    director_line = entry[1]
    if "director" in director_line:
        director = director_line.split("director")[-1].strip().strip("-").strip()
    else:
        director = director_from_message  # fallback
    titles_by_director.setdefault(director, []).append(title)
